neighbours.label: COVID-19 pandemic disrupting travel and gatherings (cancellations, shutdowns)
fire: We had booked flights to Lisbon, but then the pandemic hit and the whole trip was cancelled.
Because of COVID-19 lockdowns, the festival was called off for the second year running.
Airlines grounded most of their fleets as coronavirus restrictions closed borders.
The wedding was postponed when the government banned gatherings during the pandemic.
Hotels stood empty in spring 2020 as tourism collapsed under the lockdown.
Our school exchange to Japan was scrapped once COVID cases began to rise.
The mayor ordered bars and restaurants shut while the virus spread through the city.
Cruise bookings vanished overnight as the pandemic made travel impossible.
quiet: We had booked flights to Lisbon, and the whole trip went exactly as planned.
Because of heavy rain, the festival moved into the large tent by the river.
Airlines added extra flights as summer demand for beach holidays grew.
The wedding was held in the garden, and the guests danced until midnight.
Hotels were full in spring as tourists arrived for the cherry blossoms.
Our school exchange to Japan went ahead and the students loved Kyoto.
The mayor opened new bars and restaurants along the renovated harbour.
Cruise bookings rose steadily as more retirees decided to see the fjords.
